 UEFA YOUTH LEAGUE | FC Barcelona 3-3 Aston Villa
 A point salvaged in a game the Catalans were winning 2-0 but ended up losing until the very end

 Barça Youth 
 Published date 
 6 hrs ago

 A rollercoaster of a game at the Estadi Johan Cruyff ended with the points shared. Barça U19 surrendered a two-goal lead against Aston Villa , but recovered from 3-2 down to rescue a dramatic 3-3 draw in the UEFA Youth League .
 The blaugranes went into the game needing points. Having collected four from their opening three matches, this fourth fixture in the six-game league phase offered an important opportunity to climb the standings and strengthen their chances of progressing.
 Minute's silence for Jesús de Miguel and the victims of the Urda accident
 Pol Planas was able to call on two exciting talents, Hamza Abdelkarim and Ebrima Tunkara , for the first time in this season's Youth League. Following an emotional minute's silence in memory of Tenerife footballer Jesús de Miguel and the victims of the accident in Urda , the game got off to the perfect start for Barça.
 Tunkara goal and assist
 A move down the left saw Iu Martínez pick out Pesquer , whose cross found Tunkara . The youngster's initial header was saved, but he reacted quickest to the rebound to open the scoring (1-0, min. 9).
 It was a dream start, although Villa responded immediately, with Bonfill and then Kourouma on the goal line preventing an equaliser.
 Instead, Barça struck again. Tunkara won possession, surged forward and played in Joni Hernández , who doubled the lead (2-0, min. 23). Two moments of brilliance had put the Catalans firmly in control, but the contest was far from over.
 Downfall from corners
 Aston Villa showed just how dangerous they could be from set pieces. Bonfill initially prevented a corner from going directly into the net, but another dangerous delivery soon beat the goalkeeper and went in off Carroll (2-1, min. 38).
 Then, deep into first-half stoppage time, history repeated itself. Another inswinging corner caused problems in the Barça defence, and Carroll was there again to level the scores (2-2, min. 45+2). In between, Fortes had also rattled the crossbar with a free-kick.
 Pol Planas introduced Gistau and Miràngels at half-time, and Barça stepped up the tempo considerably. Unlike in the first half, however, the chances came without the goals. Gistau , Tunkara and Joni Hernández all went close, while Iu Martínez and Xavi Miràngels also failed to convert excellent opportunities.
 Despite the home side's growing dominance, the breakthrough simply would not come, and frustration began to mount.
 Iu Martínez late show
 Football's old saying about paying the price for missed chances came back to haunt Barça. With one of their few opportunities of the second half, Villa struck. Meade raced in behind the defence and beat Bonfill to complete the comeback (2-3, min. 81).
 But there was still one final twist. With just a minute of normal time remaining, a scramble in the Villa penalty area ended with a defensive clearance falling to Iu Martínez , who struck a superb first-time effort to rescue a point (3-3, min. 89).
 Barça almost went one better, only for a Villa defender to clear a potential fourth goal off the line.
 A thrilling encounter ultimately ended all square, leaving Barça with five points from four games ahead of their final two Youth League fixtures, away to Sabah and at home to Manchester City.
